title: Construct Good Path
constraintsSummary: Time limit: 2 sec; Memory limit: 1024 MiB; Constraints: 2 \leq N \leq 10^5; N-1 \leq M \leq \min\lbrace 2 \times 10^5, \frac{N(N-1)}{2}\rbrace; 1 \leq u_i, v_i \leq N; The given graph is simple and connected.; N, M, u_i, and v_i are integers.; S is a string of length N consisting of 0 and 1.
